newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia lending rate eases to 10.1 pct from 10.4.
newsitem.headline: Croatia lending rate eases to 10.1 pct from 10.4.

text.p: Croatia's average money market rate eased to 10.1 percent on Thursday from 10.4 percent in well-balanced trade, dealers said.
Settlements totalled 30.8 million kuna, of which most were fresh call money loans at 9.0 percent.
The one-month interbank rate was steady at 15 percent.
Earlier loans maturing today were rolled over at between 9.0 percent, charged by insurers, and 10 percent for 11-day bank funds.
The central bank's kuna midrates for Friday eased to 3.5582 versus 3.5625 against the German mark and to 5.4939 against the dollar.
